title: Newmark Arranges Sale of The Colonnade, a 1.08M-SF Office Campus in Addison, Texas
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale of The Colonnade, a three-building, 1.08-million-square-foot office campus located along the Dallas North Tollway in Addison, Texas.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale of The Colonnade, a three-building, 1.08-million-square-foot office campus located along the Dallas North Tollway in Addison, Texas.
